reviews.x: This worked great, dries quick but not too quick. Smell is not too potent either

reviews.t: Great for backing on rugs; dries clear , stays flat
reviews.x: I used it as a clear backing for a rug I crocheted (around  cording) to make it lay fly and not slip around on the floor.

I purchased this for my 12 year old daughter. She wanted to learn how to make "scars" for halloween and this was the product she wanted to try for a first timer. So far, so good. It has a low odor and uses it in a well ventilated room, to be safe. She found it very easy to use and is enjoying it. She still has a way to go, but I can see us purchasing this again. The shipping was as expected and arrived on day it was supposed to.
I can't believe I received a bottle with no lid. I mean, c'mon. I read two other reviews complaining of receiving bottles with no lids, and something tells me there are others.

reviews.t: A Epoxy Resin Creators Best Friend!
reviews.x: I love that I can cover the back of my resin projects with this latex and within an hour or two (depending on thickness I want) I am ready to pour a dome coat of epoxy and I know the latex will pull all those drips off the back of the project with ease! Not the typical use I bet but it's still amazing!!  If using for special effects it dries quickly and does create some cool effects easily!
I use this product to make my arm look gross and to add scars to my face.  Make sure to shave any arm hairs will pull it off when you take it off.

Exactly what I expected.  I've never worked with liquid latex before, so this was a new experience.  I was surprised to discover that it was easier to use than a thought.  It's a lot stronger and more durable than I expected as well.  That was a good thing too.  I was using the latex to put a latex face applicant onto a Lycra hood to turn it into a mask that could be worn over and over again.  Surprisingly it worked!  I'm very pleased with how it came out in the end.  Thank you so much.

Great product! I will buy it again, and will recommend it to others. I use it when working with resin art pieces.  I use Creature Liquid Latex - CLEAR - General Purpose Professional Special Effects Liquid Latex - 16oz - to mask off certain areas to keep the resin pieces clean in areas like the underside of a piece. I use Creature Liquid Latex - CLEAR - General Purpose Professional Special Effects Liquid Latex, and it is fun to remove, simply by rubbing it with your fingers and it just rolls off.

I'm sure it will work for what I need it for, but I'm a little annoyed that it arrived without a lid. There wasn't one in the package either so it was either never given one or taken off prior to shipping. Very odd

I love this product. I just have to be very careful not to get it on my skin,  being allergic to latex. The more you place on an object the thicker coat it will be. I use this for resin pieces bf i dome them to save on extra sanding.

reviews.t: Great for latex resist on pottery/ceramics!
reviews.x: One of my teachers recommended this to me, turns out that body latex used in costuming etc is cheaper and better quality for doing latex resist on ceramics or pottery! I have found it works great, I just like to add a little food coloring or other dye to it to make it easier to see, it is thicker and less expensive than the stuff you buy at pottery suppliers and you get more bang for your buck. Next time I will probably buy this same brand, but a colored version, so I won’t have to dye it in the

reviews.t: Came sealed but with huge globe already dried.
reviews.x: Opened the product after receiving from my PO box (so it hasn't been out in the elements) only to find congealed,  dried globs.  I've started the return process,  but now I have to send it back and reorder and my project is delayed.  Very frustrating.

reviews.t: EASY TO USE, DRIES CLEAR, CAME QUICKLY
reviews.x: PRODUCT WAS EASY TO APPLY, DRIED QUICKLY AND WAS TRANSPARENT...,,,,,BUT THERE WAS NO CAP ON THE CONTAINER.  I FINALLY FOUND A SALAD DRESSING BOTTLE LID THAT FIT THE PRODUCT. VERY ANNOYING AND UNPROFESSIONAL.  WHAT A MESS THAT COULD  HAVE BEEN.
Loved the product, was great with finishing my brothers halloween costume.  Also great with how quickly it showed up . My brother went as two face so this latex came in handy to do the makeup
My daughter is a wiz at making her own prosthetics with latex and cotton. Shes awesome. This stuff did exactly what it's supposed to. Good quality great buy.

reviews.t: Great to use with resin art
reviews.x: I used this to paint on the back of my resin keychain to prevent drips on the backside, it works perfectly for this!

reviews.t: Plenty to work with, easy to apply, great results
reviews.x: Very, very! Easy to use! With the help on a few YouTube videos at my fingertips, I was about to use this with ease.  Everything came out pretty good. It dried sheer. As with most products like this, you will have to layer it on for desired thickness. The only downside is the odor. It's definitely very strong in smell like a chemical.  And will make your eyes water,  so be careful if applying directly to skin! The smell will go away once it's dried. This supply should last a while if you're not u

I use this for keeping nail Polish off my skin and it does a great job of that. I brush it on all around the nail before painting them, let it dry, paint nails, then Peel it off. Giving me a perfect look! It bonds to skin well so I could see it working for effects. It DOES stain any fabric it touches so I suggest working away from carpet, furniture, anything it can soak into.

reviews.t: honest review, but was able to use it for my purpose
reviews.x: Pros:  *dries clear *large volume for price *can be used to create a thin translucent shiny skin effect on pre made masks  Cons:  *waaaaay too watery *consistency difficult to work with *smells terrible *takes too long to cure/dry

reviews.t: Great for miniatures painting to mask off areas
reviews.x: I like the quality of this liquid latex over most others. I use it by adding dye, then use it to mask off certain areas on miniatures that I paint to not get paint on. Then remove after paint is dry.
I've worked with a variety of latex and I must say this is the most forgiving one I've found. Being clear it blends in very well, holds product well, and is overall wonderful
Great! I use this for my resin crafts to prevent overspill and I love it! It’s easy to put on and take off even with overspill. Only complaint is it smells bad/wierd.
This is awesome latex for the price. It doesn’t have a strong smell and is easy to work with. It arrived a day earlier than scheduled!
This latex is easy to use on my resin projects, dries clear but does have an odor. Applying a thin layer will help dry faster.

reviews.t: Great for costumes and stage makeup!
reviews.x: My daughter uses it for a stage makeup class and let me tell you, Halloween costumes are going to be so fun this year!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the latex easy to use and effective for special effects makeup, prosthetics, and costumes.
Several reviewers praise it for resin work, using it as a masking or backing agent for doming and keeping projects clean.
A recurring complaint is that the bottle arrived without a lid or cap.
Reviewers note it dries quickly and clear, with a low or non-potent odor.
Some reviewers report quality or packaging problems, including dried globs and a missing lid.
